method: AST survey of cas_meta2/graph_teaching and cas_meta2/teaching_cycle for top-level definitions; names below were read from the source, not assumed

cas_meta2/graph_teaching/cube_node.py.role: the cube knowledge object: pinned bundle, six-face validation, containment graph, answer cases
cas_meta2/graph_teaching/cube_node.py.note: the cube constructor's edits must validate against validate_bundle and the face-against-branch checks; a face's existence never proves the learner can generate or use it

cas_meta2/graph_teaching/adapter.py.role: graph to task encoding and scoring boundary

cas_meta2/graph_teaching/candidate_run.p.role: the existing candidate run: proposed schedule, execution sequence, observation recording
cas_meta2/graph_teaching/candidate_run.p.note: ObservationRecorder is the existing observe/record shape; the constructor's new records extend it rather than inventing a parallel one

cas_meta2/graph_teaching/candidate_exper.role: candidate learning and the model-version identity used by write-back

cas_meta2/graph_teaching/contrast_probe..role: the rename, reorder and rewire probe cases

cas_meta2/graph_teaching/confirmation.py.role: sealed evaluation, paired analysis and verdict machinery

named_but_not_yet_enumerated.note: these modules are known to exist from the delivered work; their public names were not read in this survey and must not be assumed
modules: aws/run_evidence.py (surveyed separately this session: the preservation boundary)

part_to_binding_map.RPM: binds candidate_run's schedule and observation shape plus the new GAP_ROUTE evidence records; the return address and remaining budget are the existing control principles, not a new kernel
part_to_binding_map.evidence_acquisition: new module; reads only pinned permitted sources and records visibility and scope with each packet
part_to_binding_map.cube_constructor: binds cube_node.validate_bundle, the face-against-branch checks and containment_graph so every proposed edit is checkable
part_to_binding_map.CAS_PCBA_constructor: new typed board over adapter, candidate_experiment and the CFC modules, executed by a Python reference adapter that is labelled as such
part_to_binding_map.CFC_LL: binds face_schedule's three movements and the phase-separated batching, with the six face meanings and the seven teaching stages unchanged
part_to_binding_map.qualification_and_write_back: binds candidate_experiment.checkpoint_identity, parameter_order and state_digest for the version transition
part_to_binding_map.preservation: binds aws/run_evidence.py as completed: the constructor's future job declares its own pre-run contract

next_step: enumerate the face_*, verified_teaching, trainer and real_framework surfaces, then implement the diagnosis routes and the evidence records against these bindings
boundary: A read-only interface survey. No code was changed by this record, no model was loaded, and the recovery job's files were not touched.
